newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.

text.p: Filings for debt relief in the city of Sao Paulo dropped 43 percent to 164 in the first eight months of the year against the same period 1995, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said in a statement.
Bankruptcy filings fell six percent in August to 1,358 against July. However, August bankruptcies rose 10 percent compared to August 1995 figures, it said.
Serasa said bankruptcy filings between January and August this year increased 97 percent against the same period 1995.
Serasa said, although debt relief and bankruptcy filings have been falling gradually throughout the year, these indicators are still higher than last year.
